decoded:
secondary hydrostatic test Vessel C-18A not proceeding within nominal parameters
at approximately 10:47 local after achieving target 22.5 MPa hold pressure observed persistent pressure decay 0.08 MPa per minute over a five-minute monitoring period exceeding acceptable threshold 0.02 MPa per minute defined in procedure MNT-VSL-7
test medium potable water at 15°C
suspended test at 10:52 initiated controlled depressurization at rate not exceeding 0.3 MPa per minute
drain valve DV-7 currently open to containment sump

before any re-test authorized full inspection primary weld seam Weld-Series Gamma required
this longitudinal seam fabricated by Contractor Arclight
inspection must use portable phased-array ultrasonic tester unit PAUT-4 calibrated for 10 mm carbon steel
focus scan on a fifteen-centimeter band centered on weld crown with particular attention section between markings 7.2m and 7.8m from forward nozzle
if find any indication with amplitude exceeding 40% DAC pause capture full A-scan data set before proceeding
do not remove existing insulation layer on vessel exterior inspection must be performed through designated access ports in insulation jacket only

if no reportable indications found may proceed with re-test after obtaining sign-off from Inspector Malik
re-test pressure must be reduced to 20.3 MPa hold time extended to ninety minutes
conversely if find one or more indications above reporting level do not commence any repair
isolate vessel by closing master valve MV-11 tag it with red 'Hold for Engineering' label
then immediately transmit all collected data to central diagnostics server under project ID C18A_Gamma_Assess
priority for this analysis high please complete inspection report findings by 16:00 today
